lessons.title: Comparison Word Problems
lessons.description: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison (e.g., 35 = 5 × 7 means 35 is 5 times as many as 7). Solve word problems using multiplicative comparisons.

lessons.title: Multi-Step Word Problems
lessons.description: Solve multi-step word problems involving whole numbers and all four operations. Represent word problems using equations with a variable.

lessons.title: Factors & Multiples
lessons.description: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1-100; determine whether a number is a multiple or prime/composite.

lessons.title: Generating Patterns
lessons.description: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule, and identify apparent features of the pattern.

lessons.title: Equations & Unknowns
lessons.description: Solve multi-step word problems with whole numbers using equations with a variable standing for the unknown quantity.

lessons.title: Place Value Structure
lessons.description: Recognize that in a multi-digit whole number, a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right. Read and write numbers.

lessons.title: Rounding & Comparing Numbers
lessons.description: Use place value understanding to round multi-digit whole numbers to any place. Compare large numbers using <, >, and =.

lessons.title: Multi-Digit Addition & Subtraction
lessons.description: Fluently add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm. Solve real-world word problems.

lessons.title: Multi-Digit Multiplication
lessons.description: Multiply a whole number of up to four digits by a one-digit whole number, and multiply two two-digit numbers. Illustrate with area models.

lessons.title: Multi-Digit Division
lessons.description: Find whole-number quotients and remainders with up to four-digit dividends and one-digit divisors, using equations and rectangular arrays.

lessons.title: Equivalent Fractions
lessons.description: Explain fraction equivalence by using visual fraction models. Generate equivalent fractions by multiplying or dividing numerators and denominators.

lessons.title: Comparing Fractions
lessons.description: Compare two fractions with different numerators and different denominators by creating common denominators or comparing to benchmarks.

lessons.title: Adding & Subtracting Fractions
lessons.description: Understand addition and subtraction of fractions as joining and separating parts referring to the same whole. Add/subtract like fractions and mixed numbers.

lessons.title: Decomposing Fractions & Word Problems
lessons.description: Decompose a fraction into a sum of fractions with the same denominator in more than one way, and solve addition/subtraction word problems.

lessons.title: Multiplying Fractions by Whole Numbers
lessons.description: Understand a fraction as a multiple of a unit fraction (e.g., 5/4 = 5 × 1/4). Multiply a fraction by a whole number in word problems.

lessons.title: Decimal Fractions
lessons.description: Express a fraction with denominator 10 as an equivalent fraction with denominator 100, and use this technique to add two fractions.

lessons.title: Decimal Notation & Comparison
lessons.description: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100. Compare two decimals to hundredths by reasoning about their size (<, >, =).

lessons.title: Measurement Size Relationships
lessons.description: Know relative sizes of measurement units (km, m, cm; kg, g; lb, oz; l, ml; hr, min, sec). Record measurement equivalents in a two-column table.

lessons.title: Measurement Word Problems
lessons.description: Use the four operations to solve word problems involving distances, intervals of time, liquid volumes, masses of objects, and money.

lessons.title: Area & Perimeter of Rectangles
lessons.description: Apply the area and perimeter formulas for rectangles in real-world and mathematical problems (e.g., finding width given area).

lessons.title: Line Plots with Fractions
lessons.description: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8). Solve addition/subtraction fraction problems.

lessons.title: Understanding Angle Measurement
lessons.description: Recognize angles as geometric shapes formed wherever two rays share a common endpoint. Understand concept of angle measurement in degrees.

lessons.title: Measuring & Adding Angles
lessons.description: Measure angles in degrees using a protractor. Sketch angles of specified measure. Solve addition/subtraction problems finding unknown angles.

lessons.title: Lines, Angles & Shape Symmetry
lessons.description: Draw and identify points, lines, line segments, rays, angles, perpendicular and parallel lines, and recognize lines of symmetry.

lessons.title: Classifying Shapes & Financial Literacy
lessons.description: Classify two-dimensional figures based on parallel or perpendicular lines and angle types, and apply math to practical situations.
